 Katelin Holloway – Human Side of Venture Investing at 776 (EP.490) Mar 9, 2026

 Katelin Holloway is a Founding Partner at Seven Seven Six, a
technology-focused venture firm backing great early-stage
entrepreneurs that she started with Alexis Ohanian in 2020. Alexis
was a past guest on the show, and that conversation is replayed in
the feed.

 

Katelin and I explore the intersection of human
capital and
venture capital. We cover her upbringing, work
alongside Steve Jobs at Pixar, and turnaround of Reddit
with Alexis. We then turn to the application of
her operational experience to venture investing. We
discuss 776’s sourcing and underwriting of
founders, interviewing approach, investment selection, and scaling
the highly personal approach it takes to add
value to portfolio companies.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
